system.summary: unknown: neither file has been seen. The Münster chancery of 1658-59 used numeric alphabets with syllabaries, symbol alphabets, homophonic numeric keys and numbered code lists (W 005 Nr. 499 a); which system Körler used in 1674-75 is unknown.
system.notes: symbol_kind and key_order are placeholders: the schema has no 'unknown' value for them. 'separate passages' is the finding aid's 'zum Teil chiffriert', unseen. Input: Münster key volumes W 005 Nr. 499 a (1659) and Nr. 475 (1689), images from the DDB binaries API; not matched to any ciphertext.

prior_solution.where: Erich Hüttenheim, Die Geheimschriften des Fürstbistums Münster unter Christoph Bernhard von Galen 1650-1678 (Münster 1974) covers this chancery's ciphers and may print the Körler key or decipherments; not seen. Nothing for the 1635 letter.

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; no other input.

solution.what: DDB index and binaries API on B 001 Nr. 3009 and Nr. 673: no digital objects. Sibling B 001 Nr. 7801 (Körler alias Dorotheus Diethrichs, Vienna reports 1674) found by DDB search; not digitised either.

Downloaded and inventoried the digitised key volumes W 005 Nr. 499 a (41 images; keys of ca. 1658-59 incl. a Galen-Volmar-Montecuccoli key and a code list to 672) and Nr. 475 (67 images; a chancellor's key of 24 Feb. 1689). No key dated 1634-35 or 1674-75; nothing can be tested without the ciphertext.
Web search on Körler, Galen and Münster ciphers: found Hüttenheim 1974, the monograph on Galen's ciphers 1650-1678; not online, not seen. No other edition or decipherment.

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: neither file is digitised. Next: see Hüttenheim 1974; order B 001 Nr. 3009, 7801 and 673 from LAV NRW Abt. Westfalen; test the W 005 Nr. 499 a and 475 keys first.
